burn_cell.desc: G-BURN, the rate law integrated on the CPU twin (contract §1.6.1, §2.5.1, §2.5.2, §5.1, SM-O11, R8, R13; M0-T44b): sr_physics::reference::react — per-cell linearised backward-Euler sub-cycles under burn_dx and burn_dt on M0-T44a's ω, fractions clamped ≥ 0 and renormalised, q·ω into the energy at each sub-step, the nuclear energy booked per group — no adapter touched; one cell, T pinned, flow off, one record alone: H_burn (order 2) X = X₀/(1 + kX₀t), He_burn (order 3) X = X₀/√(1 + 2kX₀²t), Ne_burn (order 1) X = X₀e^{−kt}, each to X₀/10 within 1e-4 absolute (measured 5e-5 at burn_dx 1e-4: first-order BE at the shipped 0.1 reads 2.8e-2, bounded in shipped_limits_error), the products mass for mass, T held; the heat booked equals q·Δm of the mass the planes say moved within 1e-5 (measured 1e-15) for H_burn and Ne_burn over 9,000 sub-steps, no other group touched; in a free run E gains exactly what is booked and T rises; at the shipped burn_dx 0.1 and burn_dt 0.05 a runaway (T 100 → 18,000) holds ΔX ≤ 0.1 and ΔT/T ≤ 0.05 over 269 sub-steps and burn_dt binds (0.0499); ΣX = 1 within 1e-6 and every fraction ≥ 0 over six cells and all ten records at once; a cell burns alone — each cell of a 3 × 2 world bit for bit as the same cell in a 1 × 1 world, a vacuum cell and a cold cell untouched. The GPU's P6 (M0-T46, shaders/react.wgsl, the physics adapter): the twin's scheme in f32, with the time done, each fraction and the heat carried as compensated two-float sums (rounded per sub-step the fractions drifted 1.4e-5 and the heat 1.9e-5 over 9,000 sub-steps, measured) — the three laws to X₀/10 within 1e-4 (measured 4.6e-5 to 5.0e-5, 6,300–9,000 sub-steps, T held to 1e-5, the Fe spectator to 1e-6); heat booked q·Δm within 1e-5 for H_burn and Ne_burn in one pass each (4.0e-8, 2.1e-8), no other group; a free run's E gains what is booked and that is q·Δm, each 1e-5 (T 90 → 3615, the twin's); the runaway and six mixed cells at the shipped limits finish their pass (T 18,077), ΣX = 1 within 1e-6, nothing negative; a cell burns alone bit for bit, a cold cell untouched, a vacuum cell books nothing; a hot 8 × 8 core in a 40 × 40 cold field finishes its 1 t.u. pass (196 sub-steps at most) and the field books nothing, P6's ms printed; and the GPU's runaway against the twin (M0-D35, the Gamow law and the rate scale): G-REF's burning field marched by the twin at Δt 6.3056e-3 to the pass that runs away (47, T 143 → 18,800) and the same matter at T 2,520 — each group's booking within 1e-5 of the pass's nuclear energy (measured ≤ 1.2e-8; the trace groups C and Ne 1.3e-5 of their own value) and ΔE within 1e-5 (5.6e-8, 1.8e-8), finite, ΣX = 1, finished; M0-D34's open NaN (trace He 1e-13 in iron at T 47,000) and He_burn's peak (T 3.2e7, shift 52) finite, graded on the energy f32 resolves. q-double plants H_burn's q doubled in the twin and in the GPU's record upload; burn-clip-ln-f drops the rate scale and clips each record's ln f at 60 in the shader

burn_order.desc: G-ORDER, the ignition order on the CPU twin (contract §1.6.3, §2.5.1, §5.1, SM-O12, K6, R8, R13; M0-T44b): a cell of equal parts H, He, C, O, Ne and Si, T raised at a steady rate (T = 40 + 100 t, sampled every 0.005 t.u.), each sample the instantaneous specific power of every group (one pass of 1e-9, no fuel spent in it) — the first T at which a group's power reaches ε* = 10⁻³ Q_H per t.u. is H 147, He 164, C 244.5, Ne 335.5, O 351, Si 504 under the Gamow law (M0-D35; H 145.5 … Si 501 under the power law), strictly in the order H, He, C, {Ne, O}, Si, H's power at its crossing equal to q A Σ X² f(T) by hand within 1e-6, nothing ignites below T_thr, the group N (no iron in the cell) never passes; every record alone books into its own group and no other (C_alpha into He, Mg_burn into O, S_burn into Si, N_Fe's q < 0 into N), the heat q·Δm of the mass the planes say moved within 1e-5. swap-he-c exchanges T_He and T_C where the registry resolves a term's temperature. The GPU's P6 (M0-T46, the physics adapter): the ramp's 1,121 samples as the cells of a 40 × 29 world, one pass of 1e-9 — the same crossings as the twin (H 147 … Si 504, each within one sample, asserted), the order, H's power by hand within 1e-4 (§1.6.1's table budget), N never; every record alone books into its own group, q·Δm within 1e-5 over a pass that burns about a fifth of its input (f32's planes resolve Δm there; the twin's 1e-3 moves 4e-6)

neutrino.desc: neutrino cooling and the iron gate on the CPU twin (contract §2.5.3, §1.6.2's N_Fe, §1.8.5's latch trigger, SM-E24, R8, R13; M0-T45): sr_physics::reference::react's cooling term ε_ν = A_ν (T/T_ν)^m per unit mass for T ≥ T_ν (A_ν 10⁻³, T_ν 166, m 8) taken from E in each sub-step and from the sub-step's T limit, booked neutrino_lost, and the source S_ν = ε_νΣ kept where a cell leaves the pass with X_n ≥ 0.5 — no adapter touched; a cell held at T loses A_ν (T/T_ν)^8 Σ Δt within 1e-6 (measured 1e-15) at four temperatures and two densities; none below T_ν (0.999999 T_ν, 100, 1: bit for bit) nor with the switch off, A_ν Σ Δt just above it; S_ν = ε_νΣ in X_n 0.9 and 0.5 cells and 0 at 0.4999, 0.1, iron, the vacuum and under T_ν, the sum of S_ν Δt within what was lost; free cooling follows the ODE T⁻⁷ = T₀⁻⁷ + 7μA_νt/T_ν⁸ within 5e-3 of the drop (measured 1.8e-3, 229 sub-steps at burn_dt 10⁻³) and E loses exactly the booked loss; E gains the nuclear heat minus the loss with burning on (1e-9); N_Fe's gate on Y_eΣ: closed and bit for bit at Y_eΣ = 0.9999 Σ_N and at Σ = 160 ± 0.02 and 200 (above Σ_N, where a gate read on Σ would fire), open at 1.0001 Σ_N/Y_e for iron and for a half-hydrogen cell (Y_e 0.73) at its own threshold; N_Fe converts Fe → n mass for mass (1e-12), books q ΔX_n Σ with q = −1.14 Q_H into group N alone (1e-5), E gains it, T falls; the latch is any cell's N_Fe rate > 0, in any of five positions, unset when none; and on the GPU (M0-T47, the physics adapter, R12; step/react.rs, shaders/react.wgsl, `gpu::` cases): ε_ν taken from E in each sub-step and from the sub-step's T limit, booked into booking plane 7 of the reactions group and left in side.s_nu — a cell held at T loses A_ν (T/T_ν)^8 Σ Δt within 1e-4 (measured 9e-7) at four temperatures and two densities with T held within 1e-5, none below T_ν (0.9999 T_ν, 100, 1: bit for bit, nothing booked, S_ν 0) nor with the switch off (bit for bit, S_ν never written), A_ν Σ Δt just above; S_ν = ε_νΣ in X_n 0.9 and 0.5 cells within 1e-4 and exactly 0 at 0.4999, 0.1, iron, the vacuum and under T_ν, and rewritten every step (a cell that stopped being a source reads 0, not the last step's value); free cooling within 1e-2 of the ODE's drop (measured 1.6e-3, 272 sub-steps) with E losing the booked loss within 1e-4; E gains the nuclear heat minus the loss with burning on (1e-4); the gate on Y_eΣ in the twin's eight cases (closed cells bit for bit with the flag unset, open cells converting with it set); N_Fe converts Fe → n within 1e-6, books q ΔX_n Σ into group N alone (1e-4), E gains it; the latch flag (word 0 of Step::latch_flag, set by P6's `react_latch`) is any cell's N_Fe rate in any of five positions, and is set by a rate that closes within the step (iron 1 % over the gate, a 10⁶ t.u. step: the first sub-cycle moves 9 % of the iron and the gate shuts; a second step over the shut gate sets nothing); and a 40-step frame (two walls of cold iron, Σ = 150 at ±3 toward each other, P4 on, bounce edges) whose step 10 lifts Σ over Σ_N/Y_e stops after step 10 with the slow-down on, fired at 10 — the state, the Δt record and the box bit for bit the bare 10-step run's — and runs all 40 with it off. nfe-gate-off ignores the gate in the rate law (the twin's and the shader's), nfe-gate-sigma reads it on Σ instead of Y_eΣ (both), nfe-latch-last sets the latch from the last sub-cycle's rate only (the shader)

sink.desc: G-SINK, sinks on the CPU twin (contract §1.4.3, §2.6, §2.9, §5.1, SM-E28, SM-E29; M0-T50): scenes/sink_cloud.json — a 40 × 40 square of hydrogen at Σ = 1 drifting at (0.3, −0.2) in a 64 × 64 world, the cold pressure off by `overrides` — with a sink of mass 2000 at its centre: accretion takes the 13 cells within r_acc = 2 (r_acc = max(2, 2GM/c_sb²), c_sb = 200), grid + sink mass and momentum constant to 1e-6 relative, no cell beyond r_acc touched and no Σ raised (no mass outward across r_acc), the gas's thermal energy booked `swallowed` (0.1 per mass), gas that is hot, fast or unbound in the sink's frame refused and bound again in a sink riding with it; the cloud falling in through P2 (gas field + the sink's softened pull, §1.4.3) and P4 for 40 steps holds grid + sink mass to 1e-6 each step; formation with all four criteria at one cell on synthetic bowls of φ (Σ ≥ Σ_BH, ∇·u < 0, φ no greater than at the 8 neighbours, ½|u|² + ε_th + φ < 0), each criterion its own refusal case (the bouncing core of SM-E28's warning among them), the densest forming first, ties the lowest y then x, one a step, none past 16; kick-drift-kick (M0-D45, §0.5 [M0-V7]) against a direct sum written in the test — the sink's pull the softened sum over the gas cells at Σ ≥ Σ_vac, read at the start and at the drifted position — a vacuum leaving a lone sink on its line, two sinks' pull softened by the larger r_acc (400 and 100,000) with total momentum kept, and the no-net-force bound |Σ M_s a_s + Σ m g_s| ≤ 1e-5 of Σ M|a| + Σ m|g_s| (g_s from grav::add_sinks) on asymmetric worlds (a sink 2, 4, 8 and 16 cells from an off-centre blob, two sinks of r_acc 2 and 5, a sink accreting at the cloud's corner, counted on the cells accretion left), merging within the larger r_acc with mass and momentum summed, the sinks' potential and exact pull in grav::add_sinks; synthetic oracles beyond the cloud's mass and momentum are NOT PROVEN (synthetic); P3 on the GPU (M0-T51: Step::with_sinks, shaders/sinks.wgsl's sink_candidates over the box's tiles and sink_update in one workgroup, then M0-D46's motion — sink_pull over the box's tiles and the two half-kicks in one workgroup each — on the physics adapter) graded against the twin from the same f32 start and on the conservation itself — accretion in the cloud (13 cells, mass and momentum to 1e-6 with the sink's kick taken out by the pulls P3 reports, the motion against the twin's step to 1e-5, swallowed to 1e-5 of the twin's, every cell beyond r_acc bit for bit with the sinkless step, a second run bit for bit), hot, fast and unbound gas refused and a riding sink taking it, two sinks' r_acc over one pair of cells taking each once (the first sink's), formation where all four criteria hold and each refused alone on 64 × 64 bowls with φ uploaded, the densest first, ties the lowest y then x, one a step, none past 16, the first sink's potential taking a shallow second well's minimum, kick-drift-kick by the sum over the cloud's cells with the pair's pull and merging step by step against the twin's advance and merge (M0-D46, §0.5 [M0-V7]); the GPU's no-net-force bound at 1e-5 on M0-D45's worlds (a_s the pull of P3's closing half-kick, g_s in f64 from the sinks P3 left; the pull also against the twin's to 1e-5) and the corner's accreting sink against the twin's step; a sink outside the box (128 × 128, a blob on cells 8–15, box (0, 0, 24, 24)) moving as the twin's, as one inside it does; the 40-step fall through P2 + P3 + P4 holding grid + sink mass to 1e-6 each step (M0-D44: P4's f32 face Σ held between the cell and its neighbour, no longer 0 beside the hole the sink digs); P2's `grav_sinks` (M0-T52a): a test mass's g near a sink against −GM d/(r² + r_acc²)^{3/2} and φ against the twin's with the sinks' potential, on a lone 2 × 2 test mass with one sink and with two (r_acc 2 and 3) and on the cloud, the gas's own g bit for bit the sinkless step's (no pass reads it since M0-D46); a formation inside a frame stopping it with the slow-down on — one step run, the state and the sink a one-step run's — all steps with it off, and sinks accreting through a frame never setting the latch; nu_heat.desc: neutrino heating on the CPU twin (contract §2.5.4, §1.6.4, §2.7's f_dep, §2.9, R8, R13; M0-T53): sr_physics::reference::nuheat's P7 — D(x) = Σ(x)(S_ν ∗ K_ν)(x) with K_ν(r) = 1/(r² + 1) through the twin's FFT convolution, D = 0 where X_n ≥ 0.5, q(x) = f_dep(ΣS_ν)D(x)/ΣD — no adapter touched; on a 24 × 20 world with a 4 × 4 neutron star: Σq = f_dep ΣS_ν within 1e-9 at f_dep 0.05, 0.1 and 0.01 (0 at 0), `apply` adding exactly ΣqΔt to E and booking it; every cell within 1e-9 of the contract's direct double sum (no FFT); exactly 0 where X_n ≥ 0.5 (1 and 0.5), the share at 0.4999; nearer and denser receiving more (the kernel's ratio (64 + 1)/(9 + 1) between 3 and 8 cells, twice the Σ twice the share); a lone gas cell taking exactly f_dep of the emitted (the energy case: normalised over ΣD, never per cell); nothing when ΣS_ν = 0 (E bit for bit, nothing booked) and nothing when every cell is neutron star (ΣD = 0); f_dep above 0.1 refused by the registry while S2 is off (§1.6.4). P7 on the GPU (M0-T54: Step::with_neutrino_heating, shaders/nuheat.wgsl appended to fft.wgsl — nu_tiles and nu_gate sum S_ν in a fixed order and size the Chained rest, conv_rows / nu_columns / conv_rows_inverse the convolution on P2's kernel quarters, nu_deposit, nu_share, nu_apply, nu_close; on the physics adapter, the cold pressure off) on the 64 × 64 world with a 4 × 4 star in a 40 × 40 square of gas, from the same f32 start: q per cell as booked within 1e-4 of the twin's top over the fit box and the whole world, a second run bit for bit, nothing in the star or the vacuum; Σ q Δt = f_dep ΣS_ν Δt within 1e-5 at f_dep 0.05, 0.1 and 0.01 (measured 4e-8), E raised by what was booked to 2 ulp, f_dep 0 leaving the state a P7-less step's bit for bit; nothing inside the star (X_n 1 and 0.5 exactly, bit for bit) and the share at 0.4999; the kernel's ratio 6.5 and Σ twice twice within 1e-3; a lone gas cell 50 cells away taking f_dep of the emitted to 1e-5; no dispatch when nothing is emitted — the chain's nu_share never runs (the report's `ran`), the state and booking a P7-less step's bit for bit, the gate not sticky, and P7 costing under half the pass that convolves in the timing report (512 × 512, where the device has timestamp-query); an all-star world (ΣD = 0) depositing nothing, finite; a frame the latch stops running P7 on the steps it ran and no later one (the Chained sizes, §1.8.5). nuheat-no-cap applies f_dep twice in q on the twin; nuheat-gpu-no-cap the same in nu_share, nuheat-gpu-always-dispatch opens the chain when nothing is emitted. Synthetic worlds: the formula is proven, a collapsed star's heating is NOT PROVEN (synthetic)

summary.desc: the block summary (contract §1.9.1, §1.3.4, §3.1, R13; M0-T56): crates/sr-engine/src/summary.rs and shaders/summary.wgsl — after a frame's steps, over the box, blocks of 4 × 4 cells with mass, Σx·m, Σy·m, momentum, kinetic, thermal and cold energy, ∫Π dA, the ten species masses, Σm·φ, the max-Σ cell (index, Σ, T, X, Π_cold/Π), the frame accumulators summed, the unbound mass and the sinks inside, read back in the frame's own readback (Step::poll_frames) — on the physics adapter, a 64 × 64 hand-made world (box (0, 8, 56, 48)) with three sinks, a synthetic φ (±50 % past each cell's ½|u|² + ε_th) and signed synthetic accumulators: every field of every block against an f64 sum of the same dump within K · 2⁻²⁴ · S (K 16 stored values, 17 one product, 20 kinetic, 288 through the cold table; S the block's per-cell magnitudes), the max-Σ cell's index, Σ, X and the sinks' masks exact; the blocks tiling the box the GPU holds; ties of the max Σ to the lowest y, then x; the sinks marked in their blocks; the accumulators held in the booking until the next frame, which clears them before its first step (its summary's accumulators 0, the other booked terms bit for bit); three frames of P4 each summarised against the dump after it, and the same three submitted back to back handing over frame 0's summary once its own submission has ended, every summary the one-at-a-time run's bit for bit; two runs bit for bit. summary-skip-row drops the box's last block row. ledger.desc: the ledger (contract §2.9, §2.12.2, §5.3's G-CONS; M0-T57): crates/sr-engine/src/ledger.rs, Step::summarise and headless's summary.json `ledger` {start, end} — the mass, energy and momentum terms in f64 from the block summary's fixed-order partials, the sinks it carries, and the booked terms read and cleared after every chunk of steps (take_booked), cumulative since the ledger started (the run's first step: the box and φ exist only after it), the three invariants in each record; `bash tests/gpu.sh ledger physics` on the physics adapter, 128 × 128, 500 steps of a cold disk (a = 24, Σc = 1, the cold pressure off through `overrides`): at rest in a bounce world — mass invariant 1e-6 of the mass, momentum (grid + sinks + escaped) 1e-6 of Σm|u| (read from the final dump), nothing escaped, the energy drift reported; drifting out of a leave world's edge with gravity on — 7.5 % of the mass escapes (asserted over 0.1 % and printed), mass 1e-6, momentum held to 5e-3 of Σm|u| (source-term gravity does not conserve momentum, M0-V7 observation 1: measured 3.1e-3) a band that leaving the escaped momentum out (off by 0.23) would break; the same disk with gravity off — mass 1e-6, momentum to 1e-6 plus what a vacuum reset removes (booked nowhere, §2.7 [M0-T19]: `vacuum_reset` × the fastest gas, read from the run); in every run the ledger's grid mass and momentum against an f64 sum of the final dump's planes (independent of the summary and of the box, whose outside the ledger fills with the floor state); the arithmetic of every term and invariant on a hand-made summary (NOT PROVEN (synthetic) past the arithmetic).
